entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stood in the foyer of the Estela..."
entries.dialogueText: I stood in the foyer of the Estela Toras Royal Library, awaiting my distinguished guests.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we ate, the musicians played lou..."
entries.dialogueText: As we ate, the musicians played louder in an attempt to drown out the crowds outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stood up to address our guests."
entries.dialogueText: I stood up to address our guests.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once dinner was over, the servers c..."
entries.dialogueText: Once dinner was over, the servers carried away the table and began circulating with drinks and sweets.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus caught my eye and nodded. The..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus caught my eye and nodded. The last strains of the string quartet faded into silence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus approached me, leaned in and..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus approached me, leaned in and whispered.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It's time, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's time, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""You should get your guests into th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should get your guests into the trophy room. Sevrio and I will await your signal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I was about to enter the room, T..."
entries.dialogueText: As I was about to enter the room, Titus leaned over to me and spoke in a low voice.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The Golden Guard will be ready, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Golden Guard will be ready, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'll be waiting for your signal.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be waiting for your signal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty leaned in and whispered."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty leaned in and whispered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I was about to enter the room, a..."
entries.dialogueText: As I was about to enter the room, a member of the waitstaff whispered to me that the revolutionaries were waiting to act upon my signal.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I was about to enter the room, R..."
entries.dialogueText: As I was about to enter the room, Rusty approached and whispered in my ear.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, the doors to the atrium s..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, the doors to the atrium swung open. All eyes turned to Adarfo Sotelato as he walked in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ignoring the nobles' stares, he con..."
entries.dialogueText: Ignoring the nobles' stares, he confidently made his way to where Manus and myself were standing.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Forgive me, Your Majesty. I couldn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me, Your Majesty. I couldn't make it in time for dinner."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Murmurs of disapproval filled the r..."
entries.dialogueText: Murmurs of disapproval filled the room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The chef can warm something up for..."
entries.dialogueText: "The chef can warm something up for you if you're hungry. Do you like lobster?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can't just swagger into the ro..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't just swagger into the room like you own the place. Please show the respect my mother deserves."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for joining us, Mr. Sote..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for joining us, Mr. Sotelato."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I did not say anything."
entries.dialogueText: I did not say anything.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded towards my mother."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded towards my mother.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: !(RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ReformTalks_ViolentPlanB == true && RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Deploy_AdarfosRevolutionaries == true && RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Adarfo == true)

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo and I were the last to enter..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo and I were the last to enter. The RPP leader winked at me just before walking through the trophy room's doors.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for joining us, Mr. Spea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for joining us, Mr. Speaker."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Palantor's ready to act, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "Palantor's ready to act, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Everything's in place.""
entries.dialogueText: "Everything's in place."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You should get your guests of hono..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should get your guests of honor into the trophy room. My men will be waiting for your signal inside."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just then, a waiter came by, leaned..."
entries.dialogueText: Just then, a waiter came by, leaned in and whispered in my ear, telling me that the revolutionaries were ready to strike in the trophy room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother's portrait stood covered..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother's portrait stood covered in cloth at the head of the table, awaiting its formal unveiling.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Everything's in place, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything's in place, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Say the word, and Palantor will be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Say the word, and Palantor will be on it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The freshly renovated building towe..."
entries.dialogueText: The freshly renovated building towered over Heinricus Square at the edge of the Old Town. Its towering marble facade was topped with a luminous glass dome that was visible from all over Porte Drazon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At its center, a long dinner table..."
entries.dialogueText: At its center, a long dinner table had been brought in for the occasion. A bevy of attendants busied themselves around it, setting places and adding the final decorative touches.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The light of the setting sun shone..."
entries.dialogueText: The light of the setting sun shone down through the dome into an enormous atrium, encircled by three stories' worth of bookshelves.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could make out chants of "Reform..."
entries.dialogueText: I could make out chants of "Reform now!" and "Ax populat rizati!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could make out chants of "Down wi..."
entries.dialogueText: I could make out chants of "Down with the King!" and "Give the provinces back to the people!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we ate, I saw Titus pacing aroun..."
entries.dialogueText: As we ate, I saw Titus pacing around the room, conversing on his radio with the guards outside.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for telling me, Rusty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for telling me, Rusty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good job. Let's do this.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good job. Let's do this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I nodded."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed to my mother."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed to my mother.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Happy birthday, Madam Estela. On t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Happy birthday, Madam Estela. On this grandest of occasions, may you remember your humble roots -- those you were so quick to abandon when you married a King."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He laughed mirthlessly."
entries.dialogueText: He laughed mirthlessly.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Lobster used to be a food of the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lobster used to be a food of the poor, until elites like you made it inaccessible."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I see you haven't forgotten your o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see you haven't forgotten your own roots as a miner, Mr. Sotelato. You're still fond of striking low blows."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Happy birthday, Madam Estela. I ap..."
entries.dialogueText: "Happy birthday, Madam Estela. I apologize for ruining the mood."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I suppose we should skip the pleas..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose we should skip the pleasantries."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""All right. That's enough pleasantr..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. That's enough pleasantries for this evening."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus gritted his teeth."
entries.dialogueText: Manus gritted his teeth.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Now that Mr. Sotelato is here, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that Mr. Sotelato is here, we can begin."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Now that dinner is over, we can be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that dinner is over, we can begin."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""If the representatives from House..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the representatives from House Toras, House Azaro, House Sazon and the Rizian National Coaltion would please follow us into the trophy room."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a rustling of formalwear, the..."
entries.dialogueText: With a rustling of formalwear, the invited nobles began filing into the room, leaving my mother and the other guests in the atrium.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Good luck in there, Your Highness.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck in there, Your Highness."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'll represent the Grand Duchy wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll represent the Grand Duchy with pride, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pulled her in for a kiss as Manu..."
entries.dialogueText: He pulled her in for a kiss as Manus politely looked away.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""A new Rizian constitution. It's fi..."
entries.dialogueText: "A new Rizian constitution. It's finally happening."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Everything we've been working towa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything we've been working towards has been building up to this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They embraced excitedly before walk..."
entries.dialogueText: They embraced excitedly before walking into the room hand in hand.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From across the room, Pabel caught..."
entries.dialogueText: From across the room, Pabel caught my eye and gave me a nod of understanding.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I'll try to keep the mood light ti..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll try to keep the mood light till the talks are over. Don't be long, now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If anything happens, remember I lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "If anything happens, remember I love you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't. This will be easy.""
entries.dialogueText: "I won't. This will be easy."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His eyes filled with confusion."
entries.dialogueText: His eyes filled with confusion.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I love you, too. But I thought thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I love you, too. But I thought this was just a conversation..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you don't recognize me when I c..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you don't recognize me when I come back out, it's because I've lost weight. The weight of the Crown, I mean."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You know how the Houses are. It co..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know how the Houses are. It could be midnight before we get out of here."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You always were too confident for..."
entries.dialogueText: "You always were too confident for your own good."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""As long as the drinks keep flowing..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as the drinks keep flowing, nobody will mind."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Crown or no crown, you're still th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Crown or no crown, you're still the man I love."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a deep breath, then joined t..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a deep breath, then joined the others inside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once everyone else had entered the..."
entries.dialogueText: Once everyone else had entered the trophy room, Titus pushed the door open for me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we ate, I saw Titus occasionally..."
entries.dialogueText: As we ate, I saw Titus occasionally whispering with his fellow guards.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I tried to focus on the contents of..."
entries.dialogueText: I tried to focus on the contents of my plate and the light conversation around me. But it was difficult, knowing what was about to happen.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He winked and walked away."
entries.dialogueText: He winked and walked away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just then, a guard I'd never seen b..."
entries.dialogueText: Just then, a guard I'd never seen before came by, leaned in and whispered in my ear, telling me that the revolutionaries had infiltrated the building and were ready to strike on my command.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""You should get your guests into th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should get your guests into the trophy room. The Golden Guard and I will await your signal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita leaned in and whispered."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita leaned in and whispered.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The Azaro special forces are ready..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Azaro special forces are ready to act."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You should get your guests of hono..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should get your guests of honor into the trophy room. We'll be waiting for your signal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whatever happens, remember that I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever happens, remember that I love you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I love you, too.""
entries.dialogueText: "I love you, too."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Be careful. Nothing can happen to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be careful. Nothing can happen to our baby."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We'll stay out of harm's way.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll stay out of harm's way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Great. Let's do this.""
entries.dialogueText: "Great. Let's do this."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's for the good of the kingdom.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's for the good of the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She kissed me and waited for my ann..."
entries.dialogueText: She kissed me and waited for my announcement.
